lines.zh: 我悬在空中，慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I hover and drift across.
My discs turn around me.
I pass between the conifers.
My feet never touch ground; I float.
Half a turn around the trunk.

lines.zh: 我的外壳发出一阵轻响。
lines.en: My shell gives a soft clatter.
I drift between the end islands.
I glance at what's below.

lines.zh: 我的影子从针叶顶上滑过。
lines.en: My shadow slides over the pine tops.
I rise a little.
I stop and turn.
I drift near my anchor.
I hang still, discs turning slowly.
I'm sharpening a disc.
My eyes are rings of notches.
I listen to the wind in the pines.

lines.zh: 我把一张盘抛起，又接住。
lines.en: I toss a disc up and catch it.
I wait for my person to return.

lines.zh: 我的外壳上有旧的划痕。
lines.en: Old scratches cross my shell.
I count the discs about me.
I turn a full slow circle.
The shadows here are long.
I tuck my shell in and stack my discs.
Hovering, my gears hum thin.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能挖的地方。
lines.en: I wait for somewhere to dig.
I lay the discs out one by one.
You look up; I'm hovering.

lines.zh: 我漂浮的高度，刚好两格。
lines.en: I float exactly two blocks up.
My discs have sped up.
You'd touch me, but I'm above.
Your hand — I know its lines.
My mechanical ears are wide open.
I sink one block lower.
What's here is under my watch.
There's a mine mouth behind you.
My discs cut.
Hovering, I drift half a turn around you.
Keep clear of my discs; they cut.
I'll make you a path.
Where should I dig?
I can dig, and I can fight.
Let's drift a stretch together.
I dropped a disc.

lines.zh: 我是被造出来的机械兽。
lines.en: I'm a machine beast, built not born.
I drop half a block and catch myself.
My gears begin to stutter.
I steady myself slowly.

lines.zh: 我被砸得侧翻，齿轮空转。
lines.en: The blow tips me over; my gears spin free.
One of my discs cracked.

lines.zh: 我躲到黑森林的树干后。
lines.en: I duck behind a dark forest trunk.
You fight better than I calculated.
I need to climb higher.
I could cut through that stone.
You set it on the slab.
I drop to your height.
I know that iron.
I extend a disc.
Let me try this angle.
One turn and the stone opens.
I can smell the seam here.
What you want is below.
One more cut and it opens.
This is no trouble.
What I dig is yours.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，圆盘响了一声。
lines.en: You hit me and my discs ring.
I rise to clear you.
My shell grazes your shoulder.
Don't push; I'm unsteady in the air.
We collide and I spin twice.
You touched a spinning disc.
I drift to the other side.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我掉了一点高度。
lines.en: That dropped me a little.
I hover by your shoulder.
I rise and drift away.
Another drifts out from behind the trees.

lines.zh: 我们的圆盘碰在一起响。
lines.en: Our discs click together.
It has one more disc than I.
We hover over the anchor together.
It hands me a disc.
Our gears turn in step.
Two digging is much faster.
We drift between the islands.
It shields me from the wind.
We take turns watching here.
I pinch something up with a disc.
I open my shell and slot it into the ore bay.
This can be ground into a disc.
I toss it and catch it.
Too heavy; I can't lift it.
I set it down in front of your feet.
I clamp the ore into my back shell.
This one is a little bright.
Into the crack with it. Don't drop it.
No use for this. Dropped.
You touched the seam I guard.
All my discs start spinning.
I rise a little at a time.

lines.zh: 这片矿脉归我的盘守着。
lines.en: My discs keep watch over this seam.
Step off the seam and I'll draw my discs in.
I line myself up on you.
The first disc is already loosed.
I've logged where you're standing.
My gears have sped up.
You can still walk away. Now.
The outermost disc spins up first.
Disc out to your face in a heartbeat.
I hang two blocks above your head.

lines.zh: 我的圆盘，会自己找方向。
lines.en: My disc finds its own direction.
My disc stays aimed at you.
I'm calculating the throw.
Tree shadows won't hide you.
I slip between the trees to your back.
You look up, and a disc is aimed right at you.
I never land, and I don't tire.
One more block and the disc reaches you.
My disc turns faster.
You won't reach three.
I rise a block and look down instead.
I throw a disc.
It curves in the air.
The disc's rim cuts your hem.
You back off; the disc returns.
I ram your shoulder.

lines.zh: 盘擦过你的护甲，火星四溅。
lines.en: The disc scrapes your armor in sparks.
I throw another.
You dodged the first.

lines.zh: 我落在你背后的石头上。
lines.en: I settle on the stone behind you.
My disc is still spinning.

lines.zh: 盘的嗡声已经绕到你背后。
lines.en: The disc's whir has already gone behind you.
I rise back up slowly.
A whirring starts in the trees.
I drift out from under the canopy.
I hover above my anchor.
My discs glint first.

lines.zh: 这里多了一台悬着的东西。
lines.en: Something hovers here now.

lines.zh: 我从末地岛的边缘飘来。
lines.en: I drift in from the edge of an end island.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转着，落下一点。
lines.en: I turn slowly and settle a little.
My gears engage.
I fan out the discs around me.
I stop in the tree shadow.
My shell closes up plate by plate.
I raise my head and scan around.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的外壳，烫得响。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell until it ticks.

lines.zh: 我本该浮着，可还是摔了下去。
lines.en: I should float, yet I still fell.

lines.zh: 水进了壳里，我的齿轮卡住。
lines.en: Water gets in and my gears seize.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹得转了两圈。
lines.en: The blast spins me twice.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打穿了我的盘。
lines.en: Something punches through a disc.
That spell stops my spin.
Low on power; I can barely hover.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的盘上，火花乱窜。
lines.en: Lightning hits my discs and sparks fly.
The void draws me down.
